endorsements.quote: The governance of the consortium consists of the Management Board (MB) that includes an interplay of patient representatives (n=2); domain experts in clinical ophthalmology, epidemiology, and basic biomedical science (n=6); and experts in biomedical informatics (n=5).
A close collaboration and feedback process with clinicians will enable a user-centric design.

screen.reason: This is a perspective paper delineating strategies, governance frameworks, and plans for user-centered implementation within the EyeMatics initiative, rather than an empirical study reporting evaluated outcomes.
